analysis_scope: Fresh post-Requirement-Update analysis of v1.11. Prior complete v1.10 analysis is the baseline for unchanged content; every v1.10-to-v1.11 changed section and its affected cross-references were reviewed.

process_initiation.scope: One fresh Requirement Analysis against v1.11 only.

governing_artifacts.status: TEMPLATE_NOT_POPULATED; run-specific input supplied by the current user context and invocation response

human_decision_input.source: User-provided continuation summary in current prompt
human_decision_input.limitation: The original ask_user wording was summarized and is unavailable verbatim in resumed context. The source-qualified summary is used; the earlier reconstructed transcript is not treated as verbatim.

decisions: Critical, High, Medium, and Low are the urgency values; the shared set does not equate urgency with Ticket.Priority, and no mapping is allowed.

Support Agent scope is currently assigned tickets; Support Manager scope is currently assigned teams including team-queued tickets; Tenant Admin scope is own tenant; Platform Admin has no individual ticket urgency access.

Acceptance copies SuggestedUrgency to ReviewedUrgency; override stores a selected valid urgency; preserve SuggestedUrgency and reviewer/time metadata; urgency review never changes Ticket.Priority; any Priority change uses FR-TM-14.
decision_reassessment.cross_section_check: Aligned across FR-TK-08/09, centralized default-deny TicketAIResult/Read and ReviewUrgency mapping, §5.10, §6.14, §8 entity, §9 API, §13 acceptance criteria, §14 tests, and §18 Definition of Done.

FR-AN-06 analytics boundary and the unchanged §17 deferred decisions

deferred_questions: §17 exact generation and embedding model deployments and region.
§17 model-specific token limits and monthly cost budget.

technical_impact.api: Read/review endpoints must express TicketAIResult role/ticket scopes; API contracts remain illustrative and exact endpoints/payloads are design details.
technical_impact.application_domain: Keep SuggestedUrgency, ReviewedUrgency, and authoritative Ticket.Priority distinct; accept/override only updates review metadata.
technical_impact.database: Persist allowed urgency values and reviewer/time metadata under the existing 90-day policy; detailed schema/indexes remain implementation planning.
technical_impact.frontend: Display suggestion and reviewed urgency as distinct states and expose review controls only in the defined role/ticket scopes; this is technical impact, not an added requirement.
technical_impact.testing: Cover values, accept/override, suggestion preservation, role/tenant/team/assignment enforcement, Platform Admin denial, current authorization, retention, and no Priority mutation.
technical_impact.security_privacy: Default-deny authorization and current-scope revalidation apply to individual result reads/reviews; Platform Admin remains limited to existing aggregate analytics and cannot access an individual result.
technical_impact.performance_operations: Existing jobs, timeout, token, rate, and concurrency rules apply; §17 provider-specific choices remain deferred.

process_ordering_caveat: The predecessor analysis recorded an earlier process-ordering caveat. This attempt published and read back its own invocation before reading v1.11; that does not retroactively resolve the predecessor caveat.
